name: Yanagawa Shiori
source: The protagonist. Everyone around him thinks he has a sister complex even though he denies it. While he does recognize the beauty of his elder sisters and he does sometimes fantasize about them  he would like to have a normal relationship with them. Mostly to stop people from teasing him about it.
